member.name: T:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.Devices.UsbClient.Cdc
member.summary: This device emulates a CDC virtual COM port.
member.remarks: Your host operating system may need the driver located here. If you build a custom or composite device, you must change the driver to reflect the VID, PID, and interface number that you are using. Search for the string USB\Vid_VVVV&Pid_PPPP&MI_II in the INF file and update VVVV to your VID, PPPP to your PID, and II to you interface index.
